title: T1-T12 ROM with rib cage after VBR T6 unilateral + short T5-T7 (5 Nm)

source.authors: Liebsch C, Kocak T, Aleinikov V, Kerimbayev T, Akshulakov S, Jansen JU, Vogt M, Wilke HJ
source.sample: 6 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic spines with intact rib cage (anatomy dept. Aachen)

protocol.summary: C7-L1 with intact rib cage, C7 and L1 potted; pure moments +-5 Nm FE/LB/AR applied displacement-controlled at 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles (3rd full cycle evaluated), no preload; Vicon optical tracking of all vertebrae. Steps tested cumulatively in fixed order.
how_to_simulate: Fix L1, apply pure moments +-5 Nm to C7 in FE, LB, AR, no preload; full rib cage modelled
Model the surgical step (VBR at T6 with uni- or bilateral approach; pedicle screws T4,T5,T7,T8 or T5,T7; 5.5 mm rods)
Report T1-T12 primary full-range ROM (and NZ, coupled ROM) at 5 Nm; compare with medians and min-max of 6 specimens
protocol.notes: Test order (cumulative): 1 intact (extracted separately in fe_rom_thoracic.liebsch2020fb.*); 2 UA+LI: unilateral (left) approach, T6 vertebral body + adjacent discs + left 6th rib head and costovertebral/costotransverse ligaments removed, 3D-printed titanium VBR at T6, pedicle-screw-rod instrumentation T4-T8 (long); 3 UA+SI: as step 2 but rods shortened to T5-T7 (short instrumentation); 4 BA+LI: bilateral approach (entire T6 vertebra incl. posterior bony structures and ligaments removed, right 6th rib head cut ~50 mm from costotransverse joint), VBR + long T4-T8 instrumentation; 5 BA+SI: as step 4 with short T5-T7 instrumentation Osteoporotic old donors (BMD 38+-35 mgHA/cm3).

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: total T1-T12 primary full-range rotation at +-5 Nm, 3rd cycle; median with min-max of 6 specimens

data.step: 3 UA+SI: as step 2 but rods shortened to T5-T7 (short instrumentation)
3 UA+SI: as step 2 but rods shortened to T5-T7 (short instrumentation)
3 UA+SI: as step 2 but rods shortened to T5-T7 (short instrumentation)

extraction.from: Figs 3 (FE), 4 (LB), 5 (AR) of Liebsch 2020; bars = medians, whiskers = ranges (min-max), grey part = NZ
extraction.uncertainty: +-0.3 deg (pixel scan of the embedded figure images at ~9.3 px/deg); NZ +-0.4 deg
extraction.check_notes: Digitised by colour-mask pixel scan of embedded figure images (bar top, NZ boundary, whisker traced through bar centre). Cross-checks: intact medians reproduce the D1 intact values within 0.1 deg (FE 26.2 vs 26.3, LB 33.8 vs 33.9, AR 32.4 vs 32.5) and the red intact reference line; ratios of digitised medians reproduce the relative changes printed under each figure within ~1-2 % (e.g. LB BA+LI 27.1 -> -19.8% vs IC, printed -20%; AR UA+SI 36.6 -> +13%, printed +13%). Printed changes appear to be medians of per-specimen changes, so a few differ more (coupled AR BA+LI vs IC: -26% from medians vs -16% printed).

pass_rule.rule: min <= model <= max; sign of change vs intact matches
